title: Development
html:
Development

The CLI is written in Go 1.22+ (module github.com/Golmet/golmet-cli), with spf13/cobra as the only external dependency. 639 Go tests (unit + integration + binary e2e) back the current state.

go build ./...                    # build
go build -o golmet ./cmd/golmet   # local binary
go test ./...                     # tests
go vet ./... && gofmt -l .        # mandatory before committing
